name: Danganronpa: Eternal Endings
source:
After each dying in horrific accidents, 17 people from all across the world and time find themselves trapped in a strange purgatory like realm with only one way to free their trapped souls: spiritual murder.

[From [url=https://stephenw313.itch.io/ee]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在各自死于可怕的事故后，来自世界各地和不同时间的17个人发现自己被困在一个奇怪的炼狱般的境界中，只有一种方法可以释放他们被困的灵魂：精神谋杀。

[来自[url=https://stephenw313.itch.io/ee]Itch.io[/url]]
